title: In Silico Prediction of the Mechanism of Action of Pyriproxyfen and 4'-OH-Pyriproxyfen against A. mellifera and H. sapiens Receptors.
authors: Spaggiari, Giulia; Iovine, Nadia; Cozzini, Pietro
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究杀虫剂吡丙醚及其代谢物与蜜蜂USP-EcR和人类FXR-RXRα核受体二聚体的结合机制，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作与MD方法，但对象为小分子-核受体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Poisoning from pesticides can be extremely hazardous for non-invasive species, such as bees, and humans causing nearly 300,000 deaths worldwide every year. Several pesticides are recognized as endocrine disruptors compounds that alter the production of the normal hormones mainly by acting through their interaction with nuclear receptors (NRs). Among the insecticides, one of the most used is pyriproxyfen. As analogous to the juvenile hormone, the pyriproxyfen acts in the bee's larval growth and creates malformations at the adult organism level. METHODS: This work aims to investigate the possible negative effects of pyriproxyfen and its metabolite, the 4'-OH-pyriproxyfen, on human and bee health. We particularly investigated the mechanism of binding of pyriproxyfen and its metabolite with ultraspiracle protein/ecdysone receptor (USP-EcR) dimer of A. mellifera and the relative heterodimer farnesoid X receptor/retinoid X receptor alpha (FXR-RXRalpha) of H. sapiens using molecular dynamic simulations. RESULTS: The results revealed that pyriproxyfen and its metabolite, the 4'-OH- pyriproxyfen, stabilize each dimer and resulted in stronger binders than the natural ligands. CONCLUSION: We demonstrated the endocrine interference of two pesticides and explained their possible mechanism of action. Furthermore, in vitro studies should be carried out to evaluate the biological effects of pyriproxyfen and its metabolite.
abstract_zh: 背景：农药中毒对非目标物种（如蜜蜂）和人类可能极为危险，每年在全球导致近30万人死亡。多种农药被认定为内分泌干扰物，主要通过其与核受体（nuclear receptors, NRs）的相互作用改变正常激素的产生。在杀虫剂中，最常用的一种是吡丙醚（pyriproxyfen）。作为保幼激素的类似物，吡丙醚作用于蜜蜂幼虫的生长，并在成体生物水平上造成畸形。方法：本研究旨在探讨吡丙醚及其代谢物4'-OH-吡丙醚对人类和蜜蜂健康的潜在负面影响。我们特别利用分子动力学模拟，研究了吡丙醚及其代谢物与意大利蜜蜂（A. mellifera）的超气门蛋白/蜕皮激素受体（USP-EcR）二聚体以及人类（H. sapiens）的相应异二聚体法尼醇X受体/维甲酸X受体α（FXR-RXRα）的结合机制。结果：结果表明，吡丙醚及其代谢物4'-OH-吡丙醚能稳定每个二聚体，并且比天然配体具有更强的结合力。结论：我们证明了这两种农药的内分泌干扰作用，并解释了其可能的作用机制。此外，应开展体外研究以评估吡丙醚及其代谢物的生物学效应。
